subject: general
question: Recently, Gstar's 183N and 210RN series photovoltaic (PV) modules have achieved certification under India's latest Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) requirements. This certification has been granted under which standard?
solution:
The correct answer is __**IS14286:2023.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Gstar’s 183N and 210RN series photovoltaic modules have become among the first to receive certification under India’s latest BIS standard IS14286:2023.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The certification of Gstar’s PV modules has been granted under the updated BIS standard IS14286:2023.**
 
• BIS certification is mandatory in India for all photovoltaic modules under the Compulsory Registration Scheme.
 
• Only BIS-certified PV modules are permitted for legal import, sale, and deployment in India, including public-sector and government projects.
 
• The certification confirms that Gstar’s modules meet India’s latest technical, safety, and quality compliance requirements.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS)__

 __
 
• The national standards body of India responsible for standardization, certification, and quality assurance of goods.
 
• BIS operates the Compulsory Registration Scheme for products critical to safety and public interest.
 
 
 
• Compulsory Registration Scheme__
 __
 
• Requires mandatory certification of notified products before they can be sold or used in India.
 
• Photovoltaic modules fall under this scheme to ensure quality, safety, and performance standards.
 
 
 
• Photovoltaic Modules__
 
 
• Devices that convert sunlight directly into electricity using semiconductor materials.
 
• Used across residential, commercial, and utility-scale solar power projects.
